correctness.rationale: Quantifier rank two is in the ternary RELATIONAL multiplication language with named identity, so a two-round EF partial isomorphism checks only atomic diagrams in e,x,y; no arbitrary nested product term is atomic. These diagrams reduce to nine pointed types E,I±,T±,Q±,H± distinguished by element order and the existence of alternating square roots. A permutation x has a root in A_n only when counts of even-length cycles are even and the parity of glued pairs is even or may be corrected with two equal odd-length cycles. Applying this to involutions, order-three, order-four, and higher-order elements gives exact threshold categories, one low-degree coincidence A7≡2 A9, and mod-eight infinite oscillation. The explicit rank-two rootless-involution sentence distinguishes the recurring classes. Independent full partition-type census for n=3..40 reproduced nine category signatures and reps 3,4,5,6,7,8,10,11,12. Finite checks corroborate, whereas the cycle-root criterion and complete atomic-reduction proof cover all n.

value.rationale: The family of finite alternating groups is canonical in model theory; quantifier-rank two in a precisely fixed relational language is a natural logical invariant. Complete class count, sharp least representative size, and an explicit two-quantifier congruence witness show a structural infinite-family nonstabilization contrasting symmetric groups, not a rephrased isolated cycle table.
